**Smoother brushes, and a performance recorder**

Painting and sculpting with a large brush no longer drags the whole window down when the Diorama or the Render side is open: those views now rebuild what a stroke changed a few times a second and on their own threads, instead of compressing the edited tiles and taking the brush's own processor time every frame, and raising land no longer looks for water to fill at each touch of the brush. On a 4,096-block map with a 100-block brush, a stroke took a third of the processor time it took before. When Massif still stutters, **Help ▸ Record Performance…** records it: start it, do what is slow, click the red dot at the top right to stop, and a `.zip` lands on your desktop with every frame and where its time went, your computer and settings, the map's size and what you did, never the map itself, to send us in #bug-reports.
